title: Retail POS and Store Management Competitive Landscape

scope.description: Vendors competing with Vendit for POS, stock and store-management budgets of specialty retailers, chains and franchise formulas in the Netherlands and Belgium.
scope.inclusionLogic: Included: global cloud POS vendors active in the Benelux (Lightspeed, Shopify POS, SumUp POS), ERP suites with a native POS app sold to Benelux SMB retailers (Odoo), Dutch POS vendors serving specialty retail (MplusKASSA, MicroCash), and branch specialists in Vendit's strongest branches (two-wheelers: CycleSoftware, Wilmar). Excluded: Katapull siblings (Logic4 is a group-internal upgrade path, not a competitor), payment-terminal-only providers and pure webshop platforms.
scope.notes: Business stats only where an official source was found; private Dutch vendors publish only self-reported counts (customers, active registers, team size) on their own sites, recorded as company claims. Vendit itself publishes no revenue.

players.name: Lightspeed Commerce
players.description: Cloud POS and commerce platform for retail and hospitality, with Lightspeed Retail offered in the Netherlands and Belgium; competes for growing specialty retailers wanting cloud POS with integrated payments.

businessStats.sourceTitle: Lightspeed Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results

players.name: Shopify POS
players.description: Point of sale tied to the Shopify commerce platform; attractive to online-first retailers opening stores, less specialised for branch supplier links and repairs.

players.name: MplusKASSA
players.description: Dutch family-owned POS vendor since 1985 for hospitality and retail including specialty stores and garden centres, sold through resellers with an open API and 150+ integrations.

players.name: CycleSoftware
players.description: Cloud POS and business software built for the two-wheeler trade (shops, workshops, chains); competes head-on with Vendit's bike branch offering.

players.name: Wilmar
players.description: Online software package and IT services for bicycle shops, workshops and rental businesses.

businessStats.value: 1992 (registered with KvK as WilMar V.O.F.; origins 1983)

players.name: SumUp POS
players.description: Payments-led SMB commerce provider whose POS (kassasysteem) bundles a two-screen till, barcode scanner, real-time stock and a POS Plus subscription; competes for small independent shops in the Netherlands and Belgium on low entry price and integrated card payments, with little branch-specific supplier or franchise depth.

players.name: Odoo Point of Sale
players.description: Belgian open-source ERP whose Point of Sale app shares inventory, purchasing, accounting and eCommerce with the rest of the suite; sold through a large Benelux partner network to SMB retailers and multi-store chains wanting one integrated back office instead of a dedicated retail POS.

players.name: MicroCash
players.description: Dutch POS vendor since 1993 for independent specialty retailers (drugstores, pet shops, tobacco, perfumeries, liquor, supermarkets) with stock management, supplier connections and reorder suggestions, loyalty, webshop stock sync and multi-store management; overlaps Vendit's specialty-retail and supplier-link proposition.

businessStats.scope: company claim (active cash registers, not customers)
